title: Near-uniform all-direction characteristic scan
question: Do the qualified Nulloth characteristic gates remain healthy over near-uniform spherical propagation coverage at boundary and seeded interior states?
prediction: All 3,072 state-direction pairs remain activated, causal, and strongly hyperbolic; the 256-direction covering radius remains below 0.18 radians; condition numbers remain below 100 and all constitutive minima remain positive.
falsifier: Any sampled direction fails a causal, rank, eigenspace, reduction, Legendre, thermodynamic, activation, or angular-coverage criterion.
controls: Four deterministic boundary states include orthogonal and counter-propagating material and carrier velocities.
Eight seeded interior states independently vary both velocity orientations and all scalar-domain coordinates.
Each state is evaluated on the identical 256-point Fibonacci sphere; a separate 4,096-point probe sphere estimates the largest angular hole.
Raw and regular scalar-constraint-reduced spectra, repeated eigenspaces, and constitutive convexity gates are checked at every direction.
Characteristic multiplicities and distinct-family counts are recorded rather than inferred from a single axis.
seed_rationale: Eight interior physical states are generated from a fixed NumPy seed; the boundary states and direction sphere are deterministic.
